# Physiological Rights

> {{ site.description }}

This site argues that physiological rights constitute a justiciable category of human rights — distinct from and complementary to the right to health and the right to food. Every person has the right to the maintenance, protection, and active restoration of their normal physiological parameters and essential biological functions.

Base URL: {{ site.url }}/

---

## Specific Physiological Rights

Each page documents a specific physiological right: scientific context, systematic violations, and applicable legal framework.
